result.instructions: Tools for Ragic, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the open support tickets in our Ragic support sheet and show the newest 20."; "Find the customer record with the phone number 555-0100 and show its fields."; "Create a new lead in the sales sheet with the name, email and company from this note.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Ragic data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ragic_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ragic_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ragic_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. ragic_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ragic_get_sheet_schema
tools.title: Get sheet schema
tools.description: Return a sheet's field definitions: field ids, names, types and subtables, without records. Use it first to learn the field ids. Ragic allows this only to account managers. Ragic API: GET /<account>/<tab>/<sheet>/metadata/schema.

tabPath.description: Tab folder path of the sheet, e.g. "sales" or "hr/candidates" (the part between the account name and the sheet index).

sheetIndex.description: Sheet index from the sheet URL, e.g. 1 in ragic.com/acme/sales/1.

tools.name: ragic_list_records
tools.title: List records
tools.description: List records of one sheet, with optional filters, ordering and paging. Each where filter compares one field by its numeric id. Returns an array of {recordId, fields} in Ragic order, up to a size budget; when hasMore is true, call again with offset set to nextOffset. Ragic API: GET /<account>/<tab>/<sheet>.

tabPath.description: Tab folder path of the sheet, e.g. "sales" or "hr/candidates" (the part between the account name and the sheet index).

sheetIndex.description: Sheet index from the sheet URL, e.g. 1 in ragic.com/acme/sales/1.

where.description: Filters, combined with AND. Several eq/like/regex on one field combine with OR.

operator.description: eq equals; like contains; regex matches; gt/gte/lt/lte compare numbers or dates (yyyy/MM/dd); eqeq matches a node id.

value.description: Value to compare. Leave out to match empty fields (use with eq).

offset.description: Records to skip before the first one returned (default 0).

order.description: Sort by one field. Default: creation order, oldest first.

reverse.description: Return the newest records first (ignored when order is set).

naming.description: Key names in the result: EID = field ids, FNAME = field names. Default: field names.

tools.name: ragic_get_record
tools.title: Get a record
tools.description: Return one record of a sheet by its record id, with all top-level fields. Ragic API: GET /<account>/<tab>/<sheet>/<record>.

tabPath.description: Tab folder path of the sheet, e.g. "sales" or "hr/candidates" (the part between the account name and the sheet index).

sheetIndex.description: Sheet index from the sheet URL, e.g. 1 in ragic.com/acme/sales/1.

recordId.description: Record id: the last number in a record URL.

naming.description: Key names in the result: EID = field ids, FNAME = field names. Default: field names.

tools.name: ragic_create_record
tools.title: Create a record
tools.description: Create one record in a sheet. Writes the given top-level field values; the API key's user needs write access to the sheet. Not undoable through this tool: use ragic_delete_record to remove it. Ragic API: POST /<account>/<tab>/<sheet> (JSON).

tabPath.description: Tab folder path of the sheet, e.g. "sales" or "hr/candidates" (the part between the account name and the sheet index).

sheetIndex.description: Sheet index from the sheet URL, e.g. 1 in ragic.com/acme/sales/1.

fields.description: Field values keyed by numeric field id, e.g. {"2000123": "Acme", "2000125": "555-0100"}. Top-level fields only.

tools.name: ragic_update_record
tools.title: Update a record
tools.description: Change the given top-level fields of one record; other fields stay as they are. Subtable rows are not changed by this tool. Ragic API: POST /<account>/<tab>/<sheet>/<record> (JSON).

tabPath.description: Tab folder path of the sheet, e.g. "sales" or "hr/candidates" (the part between the account name and the sheet index).

sheetIndex.description: Sheet index from the sheet URL, e.g. 1 in ragic.com/acme/sales/1.

recordId.description: Record id: the last number in a record URL.

fields.description: Field values keyed by numeric field id, e.g. {"2000123": "Acme", "2000125": "555-0100"}. Top-level fields only.

tools.name: ragic_delete_record
tools.title: Delete a record
tools.description: Delete one record from a sheet by its record id. The record is removed from the sheet. Ragic API: DELETE /<account>/<tab>/<sheet>/<record>.

tabPath.description: Tab folder path of the sheet, e.g. "sales" or "hr/candidates" (the part between the account name and the sheet index).

sheetIndex.description: Sheet index from the sheet URL, e.g. 1 in ragic.com/acme/sales/1.

recordId.description: Record id: the last number in a record URL.

tools.name: ragic_set_record_lock
tools.title: Lock or unlock a record
tools.description: Lock a record so users cannot edit it, or unlock it. The permission rules are the same as in the Ragic form. Ragic API: POST /<account>/<tab>/<sheet>/<record>?lock or ?unlock.

tabPath.description: Tab folder path of the sheet, e.g. "sales" or "hr/candidates" (the part between the account name and the sheet index).

sheetIndex.description: Sheet index from the sheet URL, e.g. 1 in ragic.com/acme/sales/1.

recordId.description: Record id: the last number in a record URL.

locked.description: true locks the record, false unlocks it.
